newsitem.title: USA: Calif. Gov. appoints state mandates commissioner.
newsitem.headline: Calif. Gov. appoints state mandates commissioner.

text.p: Gov. Pete Wilson on Tuesday appointed Dave Cox to California's Commission on State Mandates.
Cox, a Republican, has served as a member of the Sacramento County Board of Supervisors since 1993.
The commission is responsible for deciding claims from local government agencies and school districts requesting reimbursement for costs mandated by the state.
Members of the commission do not receive a salary. The appointment is subject to state Senate confirmation.
